single_family.title: Single-Family Home Open House Sign In Sheet, QR Code Digital Sign-In, Property Page in Google Sheets, Paperless Open House Kit for Agents
single_family.description:
A paperless open house kit for a single-family home. Visitors scan your QR sign, sign in on their phone, and their details land in your own private Google Sheet. They also get a mobile property page with photos, key facts, room-by-room details, open-house times and your contact buttons. No apps, no code, no monthly fee.

Made for real estate agents and sellers who are done with paper sign-in sheets and messy handwriting.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD: after purchase you receive a PDF with your copy links, your setup page link and a step-by-step guide. Setup takes about 20 minutes.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
HOW IT WORKS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Copy the property sheet and type over the example.
2. Copy the sign-in form and the private tracker, and link them (step-by-step in the guide).
3. Paste your sheet link into the setup page: it checks everything in plain words.
4. Print your QR sign (Letter or A4) and put it by the door.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT VISITORS SEE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• A mobile property page: price, headline, photos, key facts, highlights, rooms, neighborhood, documents
• "Next open house" with Add to calendar and Map buttons
• Call, Text and Email buttons for you
• A sign-in button with a clear consent line naming you
• All in 12 languages, automatically: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi and Russian

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT YOU GET
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Lead tracker: every sign-in in your private Google Sheet, with visitors per open-house date, private showings requested and follow-up status
• Sign-in form: name, email, phone, "working with an agent?", what they want, and a required consent checkbox
• Printable QR sign in Letter and A4, with your price, address, next date and contact details (PDF or PNG)
• Setup page that checks your sheet for sharing, broken links, visitor data in the wrong place and fair-housing wording
• Pre-filled example: a fictional 4-bedroom house: highlights, room-by-room, neighborhood and schools. Just type over it
• Step-by-step PDF setup guide with privacy and consent tips

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EDIT ANY TIME
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Price changed? New photos? Edit one cell in Google Sheets, from your computer or phone. The page updates and the same printed QR code keeps working. Reprint the sign only if you want a new price or date on it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT YOU NEED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• A free Google account
• About 20 minutes for the first setup (a computer is easiest)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
GOOD TO KNOW
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• This is a digital product. Nothing will be shipped.
• Works alongside any listing website, brokerage or CRM. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any listing service, brokerage, real estate association or Google.
• Visitor details go only to your private tracker, never to the public property page. You are responsible for following the contact and privacy rules where you work; the consent wording and tips are a starting point, not legal advice.
• The example content describes a fictional property, agent and brokerage.
• For your own listings: make one copy of the property sheet per property. Please don't share or resell the template.
• Designed by Handy Helper Studio with the help of AI tools.
• Because this is a digital download, returns aren't possible, but if anything doesn't work as described, message us and we'll help you get set up.
